page: UpCloud STARTER-2xCPU-16GB is a virtual server instance configured with two vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance utilizes the x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor. The CPU operates at a base speed of 2.0 GHz and features two physical cores with one thread per core under a shared CPU allocation model. Cache specifications include 64 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache.

The instance includes 50 GB of local SSD storage and comes bundled with one complimentary public IPv4 address. It does not feature any dedicated GPU hardware. The underlying AMD EPYC processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration features such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

Because the CPU allocation is shared, this instance is positioned as a budget-friendly option where resource density is prioritized over dedicated, sustained compute performance. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require continuous maximum CPU utilization. Appropriate use cases include lightweight databases, caching layers, staging environments, and general-purpose web serving.
